# Command-Line Help for `vault-push`

This document contains the help content for the `vault-push` command-line program.

**Command Overview:**

* [`vault-push`↴](#vault-push)

## `vault-push`

Reads per-conversation .jsonl files (message-ir schema v3) plus attachments/, uploads media by SHA-256, then imports message batches.

Prefer VAULT_KEY for the vault key. Prefer Message Vault → Vault for a GUI.

**Usage:** `vault-push [OPTIONS] --url <URL> --key <KEY> --input <INPUT>`

###### **Options:**

* `--url <URL>` — Vault base URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080)
* `--username <USERNAME>` — Vault account username (optional; resolved from the vault key)

  Default value: ``
* `--key <KEY>` — App password / Vault key (Settings → Account). Prefer VAULT_KEY env
* `--input <INPUT>` — Export directory containing .jsonl files and attachments/
* `--mode <MODE>` — Import mode: append: add to existing data (safe to re-run); replace: delete existing messages for this source, then import

  Default value: `append`
* `--continue-on-error` — Continue after a failed conversation

  Default value: `true`
* `--force` — Ignore journal; re-upload assets and re-import messages
* `--skip-attachments` — Import messages without uploading attachments
* `--verify-digests` — Hash attachments and fail when on-disk sha256 differs from export digest_sha256

  Default value: `false`
* `--trust-export` — Trust export metadata: skip re-hashing attachments when size_bytes matches the file size on disk. Without this flag every attachment is re-hashed

  Default value: `false`
* `--max-retries <MAX_RETRIES>` — Max retries for transient HTTP errors

  Default value: `3`
* `--batch-size <BATCH_SIZE>` — Messages per import request

  Default value: `1000`
* `--asset-upload-workers <ASSET_UPLOAD_WORKERS>` — Simultaneous attachment uploads; message imports remain sequential

  Default value: `8`
* `--prepare-ahead <PREPARE_AHEAD>` — Conversations to prepare (read + upload media) ahead of the import loop

  Default value: `3`
* `--prepare-workers <PREPARE_WORKERS>` — Worker threads that prepare conversations ahead of import

  Default value: `2`
* `--asset-max-bytes <ASSET_MAX_BYTES>` — Max attachment size in bytes (must not exceed vault server.asset_max_bytes)

  Default value: `536870912`
* `--auth-only` — Authenticate only; do not import
* `--report <REPORT>` — Report JSON path (default: <input>/vault-push-report.json)
* `--log <LOG>` — Log path (default: <input>/vault-push.log)
* `--journal <JOURNAL>` — Journal path (default: <input>/.vault-import-state.jsonl)
